what: Clicking a same-page link (#) glides down to the target position, offset by the fixed header height, with .8s easeOutQuart, and if the target is a folded height-fold it opens that fold too — like a region button on a map opening the region accordion below and taking you to that row. When it ends, it briefly focuses the target to move the keyboard position, and wheel·touch input stops the glide. If href is just #, it goes to the top

options.ease: Curve — a GSAP name or a,b,c,d, default power3.out (same formula as anime.js easeOutQuart, 1-(1-t)^4)
options.offset: Float height — a number (px) or css of a fixed header (its clientHeight), default header
options.open: If false, the target fold does not open and only slides
options.target: Where a button without an href goes (#id)

from.where: index.html .my-map__nav region buttons → .my-area region accordion (original main.bundle.js: a[href^="#"] pressing scrolls scrollTop with anime.js to the target top − .js-header height over 800ms easeOutQuart, and data-accordion-open opens the accordion on the same press with a 600ms ease) · back-to-top button (#header → 0)

note: Folding is the head of height-fold (data-fx-part=head) is pressed to open it, and the fold part’s options (length, curve) apply as they are. For an in-app scroll panel, put data-fx-scroller on that panel
